# mast's CLI surface: flag names, types, defaults, subcommand verbs, and
# exit codes. This is a frozen contract as of v1.0 — see DESIGN.md, "The
# v1.0 stability promise". The binary is a first-class consumer shape
# alongside the library, and its callers are shell scripts, systemd
# units and Kubernetes manifests whose compiler cannot see this repo, so
# nothing else in the tree fails when a flag is renamed.
#
# A diff here is an intentional CLI change. Adding a flag or a verb is a
# minor; renaming or removing one, or changing a type, a default, or
# what an exit code means, is a major.
#
# Deliberately absent: usage strings. Help text is prose and is not part
# of the promise; pinning it would make every wording fix a contract
# diff and teach readers to update this file without looking.
#
# Regenerate: go test ./cmd/mast/ -run TestCLISurface -update

exit codes
  0  ok            the work completed
  1  failure       the work was attempted and failed
  2  usage         the invocation was rejected before any work started
  3  drain-expired serve mode only: the shutdown drain expired with sessions still interrupted

mast [flags] [prompt]
  --a2a-listen           string    ""
  --agui-listen          string    ""
  --attach-listen        string    ""
  --auto-resume          bool      "true"
  --auto-resume-window   duration  "1h0m0s"
  --dispatch             string    ""
  --listen               string    ":7777"
  --log-level            string    "info"
  --mcp-digest           bool      "true"
  --model                string    "echo"
  --notify-url           string    ""
  --provider             string    ""
  --session-db           string    ""
  --session-db-driver    string    "sqlite"
  --task                 string    ""
  --timeout              duration  "5m0s"
  --version              bool      "false"
  --watchdog             string    ""
  --workload             string    ""

mast sessions <verb>
  verbs: abort ack-effects export-decisions extend-token list pause resume show

  mast sessions abort
    --addr                 string    "http://127.0.0.1:7777"
    --reason               string    "operator abort"

  mast sessions ack-effects
    --addr                 string    "http://127.0.0.1:7777"
    --app                  string    "mast"
    --reason               string    "operator ack"
    --session-db           string    ""

  mast sessions export-decisions
    --app                  string    "mast"
    --include-approver     bool      "false"
    --out                  string    ""
    --session-db           string    ""
    --since                string    ""
    --until                string    ""
    --user                 string    ""
    --workload             string    ""

  mast sessions extend-token
    --addr                 string    "http://127.0.0.1:7777"
    --ttl                  string    ""

  mast sessions list
    --app                  string    "mast"
    --session-db           string    ""
    --state                string    ""
    --user                 string    ""

  mast sessions pause
    --addr                 string    "http://127.0.0.1:7777"
    --interrupt            bool      "false"
    --message              string    ""
    --reason               string    ""
    --resume-after         string    ""
    --resume-at            string    ""
    --ttl                  string    ""

  mast sessions resume
    --ack-effects          bool      "false"
    --addr                 string    "http://127.0.0.1:7777"
    --app                  string    "mast"
    --interrupt            string    ""
    --response             string    ""
    --session-db           string    ""
    --token                string    ""

  mast sessions show
    --app                  string    "mast"
    --session-db           string    ""
    --user                 string    ""

mast stop
  --addr                 string    "http://127.0.0.1:7777"
  --pause-sessions       bool      "false"
  --reason               string    ""
